versions.changelog:
Initial release of image-to-video generation using RunComfy models.

- Converts any still image into a short video using the RunComfy Model API.
- Supports general image animation, lip-sync with custom audio, and multi-modal (image + reference video/audio) outputs.
- Detects user intent to route requests to the correct image-to-video model and endpoint.
- Requires RunComfy CLI, account, and configuration.
- Triggers on common image-to-video requests like "animate image" or "image2video".
